test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Given below are three statements and three conclusions. Take the statements to be true even if they are at variance with commonly known facts, and decide whether the conclusion/s follow/s the given statements.

**Statements :**

I. All grasses are shrubs.

II. All roots are fruits.

III. All fruits are flowers.

**Conclusions :**

I. All grasses are flowers.

II. All roots are flowers.

III. Some flowers are fruits.
solution:
**Statements:**

I. All grasses are shrubs.

II. All roots are fruits.

III. All fruits are flowers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6cb44a120880bfa39327b639b046faf60e5860e49f6c85d8d8e64ff095d2a81.png] 

Conclusions :

(I) All grasses are flowers → False (As there is no direct relation between grasses and flowers. So, we can not conclude anything about their relationship.)

(II) All roots are flowers → True (As all roots are fruits and all fruits are flowers. So, all roots will be flowers)

(III) Some flowers are fruits → **True** (As all fruits are flowers. So, Some flowers will be fruits.)

Hence, "Conclusion II and lll follows" is the correct answer.
